sentences.text: This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.02/2024 registered at Police Station Sarrai, District Singrauli (thereafter transferred to Police Station Ghamapur, District Jabalpur), for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
The applicant is in jail since 17.01.2025.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the case has been registered on the basis of a complaint made by the prosecutrix that the applicant on a false pretext of marriage has developed physical relations, although, the prosecutrix was a married lady and therefore, her case and allegation prima facie appear to be false and it is clear that a false case got registered against the applicant.

Affidavit of the prosecutrix is also on record showing that she has made a false complaint against the applicant and also NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:5750 2 MCRC-5461-2025 stated that the applicant was her good friend.
3. On the other hand, the counsel for the State has opposed the prayer of bail.

4. Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case Akash Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34907826/
1 diary, I am inclined to allow this bail application.

entities.text: Akash Jaiswal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
6. On being released on bail, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 480(3) of BNSS.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
